options.content: Recommendations computed like [KRR](https://github.com/robusta-dev/krr) `simple` strategy over **$history** of history: **CPU request** = p(`$cpu_percentile`) of usage (max across pods, min 10m), **CPU limit** = unset; **memory request = memory limit** = peak working set × `$memory_buffer` (min 100Mi). Only workloads with running pods are shown. Δ < 0 (blue) means over-provisioned, Δ > 0 (orange) means under-provisioned.

panels.title: CPU requested (cores)

targets.expr: sum(sum by (namespace, workload_type, workload, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace=~"$namespace", resource="cpu", container!=""} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload, workload_type) (max by (namespace, pod, workload, workload_type) (namespace_workload_pod:kube_pod_owner:relabel{namespace=~"$namespace", workload_type=~"$workload_type", workload=~"$workload"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace=~"$namespace", phase="Running"}) == 1))))
